scope: GSDC2023 train entries in the local archive only

inventory_contract.archive_integrity: profile SHA-256 must match before selected member extraction

candidate_selection_rule.description: After excluding the development and designated holdout IDs, retain only train route/phone pairs with all three phone CSVs and route-level brdc.nav. Select one pair from each of 2021, 2022, and 2023, maximizing distinct phone model and route-region strata; ties are resolved by the lexicographically smallest dataset ID. Before the final evaluation, a signal-only eligibility screen confirms at least one GAL_E1_C_P row; it reads no truth and any failed route is recorded as ineligible before the final fixed set is frozen.
avoidance_constraints: at least one GAL_E1_C_P row (signal-only eligibility; no truth read)
do not inspect truth while selecting or screening

evaluation_freeze.signal_lane: promoted Galileo E1 with Hatch C1C window 30 seconds
evaluation_freeze.trajectory_baseline: truth-free constant-velocity Kalman/RTS, process_noise=1.0, measurement_floor_m=1.0, outlier_gate_sigma=5.0, segment_gap_s=10.0
evaluation_freeze.imu_candidate: causal gyro/acceleration norm process-noise multiplier; window=1.0s, max sample gap/age=0.25s, gyro threshold=0.25, acceleration dynamic threshold=1.0, multiplier=2.0
evaluation_freeze.truth_use: ground truth is read only after both truth-free pipelines publish artifacts, for post-hoc scoring
evaluation_freeze.truth_gap_policy: explicit --allow-missing-truth is used for route tails with no reference row; scores report exact matched coverage and do not interpolate absent truth
evaluation_freeze.official_metric: not asserted; local public-spec-compatible distance diagnostics only

post_evaluation.initial_screening_note: The first structurally selected 2022-07-26-21-01-us-ca-sjc-s/samsunga325g route was opened only through the development adapter's signal path and failed closed because no GAL_E1_C_P was present. It was not scored or substituted silently. The final frozen 2022 candidate was selected from the predeclared E1-capable train pool.
